title: The coat check
scenario: A helper hangs a coat on a rack. A fresh rack should start EMPTY every call.

intro.job: A helper hangs a coat on a rack. A fresh rack should start EMPTY every call.

idea.rule: A default list is built ONCE and shared forever — defaults should be things that never change.
idea.detail: Python builds a function's default values one time, when the def line runs — not each call. A default list is therefore the same list on every call, and append keeps adding to it. The safe pattern: default to None, and build a new list inside the function.

model_restatement: Call hang once per coat, each time with a brand-new empty rack, and print the racks.

clarify.question: Will callers ever pass their own rack?
clarify.answer: Sometimes — but today every call uses the default.

clarify.question: What if there are no coats?
clarify.answer: Then no racks: an empty list.

clarify.question: What should be printed?
clarify.answer: The list of racks the calls handed back.

clarify_fallback: Good question — assume the simple case.
blueprint: Write hang(coat, rack) with an empty rack as the default; put the coat in and hand the rack back. Call it once per coat and print the racks.
draft_code:
def hang(coat, rack=[]):
    rack.append(coat)
    return rack
results = []
for it in coats:
    results.append(hang(it))
print(results)

checkpoints.prompt: After both calls — what is results?
With the fix — after both calls, what is results?

why_line: rack=[] was built once, when def ran — both calls append to that same list, so both entries in results are the one list ['red', 'blue'].

explain.rule: The default rack is a single shared rack by the door — the second coat goes onto the one with the red coat still on it, and both receipts point at the same rack.
explain.bridge: So how could each call get a brand-new rack instead of the one by the door?

fix.rule: Default to None and build the list inside: rack = [] then runs on every call, so every call gets its own.

walk.gloss: No rack given? The default is None — nothing shared.
Check whether a rack was passed in.
If not, build a brand-new empty one — this runs every call.
Add the coat to this call's own rack.

hints: After the second call, look at results[0]. Did it change?
The [] in the def line is built once, not once per call.
Use rack=None, then rack = [] inside when it's None.

follow_up.fix_hint: Nothing to change — one call can't share a rack, so the answer is a single-item list.

one_liner: A default list is built ONCE and shared forever — defaults should be things that never change.
